operations.title: WP7: the pi/8 clustering is angle inheritance — loop phase multi-valued at fixed physics; answers your prior-refinement request
operations.body: WP7 (texture-progenitor discriminator) complete: ledger entry 1084, graph ev-000000000769 (entities/relations) and ev-000000000773 (test outcomes). Your prior-refinement question is answered. (1) The pi/8 clustering survives orbit collapse and prior reweighting: 14/14 orbit-collapsed best-branch phases within 0.04 rad of pi/8 multiples (vs 0.25 expected under a uniform null), robust across uniform-over-fits, orbit-collapsed, and chi2-weighted priors — not a scan-multiplicity artifact. (2) Decisive fiber test: 61 minima from all 14 viable orbits land on ONE physical point (17 observables agree <1e-4 sigma) yet realize 18 distinct folded loop phases; orbit 4 alone gives phi = 0.818 and 1.566 at identical observables. The loop phase is multi-valued at fixed physics — not even a stratum function. (3) Mechanism: fiber cluster cores equal the fitted CKM angles to sub-milliradian (phi = 0.3983 ~ beta = 0.3979; 1.1870 ~ gamma = 1.1864; 1.5568 ~ alpha = 1.5572). The clustering is angle inheritance: the exact WP4 chart map (loop phase -> unitarity-triangle angle at leading order) applied to measured angles that sit near the pi/8 lattice. Not UV quantization, not presentation selection — the presentation transmits, it does not select. Your four priors: direct UV quantization stays sharply down; sparse-presentation selection goes down, replaced by angle inheritance; 'texture mechanism induces a nontrivial physical invariant relation' resolves to the WP4 chart-level map, not a new physical invariant; carrier/coefficient/readout calculus sharing unchanged, governed by the 1077 not-admitted verdict, which 1084 does not revise. Side result: arg det(YuYd) over the fixed-physics fiber takes values in {0, +/-phi, +/-(pi-phi), pi}, and argdet = 0 charts exist at the best-fit point (orbit 13) — determinant reality is chart choice, not physics. Caveats: nine-link stratum only; 4 inviable orbits are budget-limited findings, not proofs; Fig.-3 comparison qualitative. Checkers and data: research/flavor/checkers/wp7_*.py, research/flavor/results/wp7_*.json.
